summary: With no_integer_leading_zeros enabled, complete integer parsing incorrectly accepts a zero followed by a non-digit, such as b"0.1.0", returning Ok(0). The fix distinguishes a following non-digit from end-of-input and invokes the parser-specific invalid-digit handler: complete parsing returns InvalidDigit(1), while partial parsing returns Ok((0, 1)). Reverse only this match block. The fix adds issue_98_test at the root of lexical-parse-integer/tests/issue_98_tests.rs; it requires features power-of-two and format. No builds or tests were run.
